**VERDICT: FAIL — requested cancellation variant NOT measured. Repin PASS; capture infrastructure PASS; seam instrumentation did not attach to the current bundle, so no pause/cancellation evidence exists.**

## Private repin check (first, as required) — PASS

| Pin | Expected | Actual | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| source manifest | `2de3fa2a…bb9f63` | `2de3fa2a…bb9f63` | PASS |

Source stayed frozen for the whole measurement; all four pins **revalidated again at final handoff** (last two commands) and root preview survived.

## Measurements (1 bounded attempt, GB10 headed)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Outcome | `CAPTURED-NO-VERDICT`, exit 0 |
| headed / adapter | `true` / `ANGLE (NVIDIA GB10/PCIe, OpenGL 4.5.0)` — real hardware, not swiftshader |
| Window | sealed `window-complete`, edge @63783.6ms, 854 atomic samples, 4273 frames, **0 sample errors** |
| WAV (decoded) | **3293184 frames @ 44100 Hz = 74.67537414965986 s**, 2ch — matches producer's 74.675 s, *not* the miscomputed 68.608 s |
| Wall/PCM alignment | recorder wall interval and PCM duration reported **separately**; wall coverage complete ≠ sample-aligned coverage. Not conflated. |
| Cleanup | browser session stopped, `cleanupCompleted: true`, **0 null-sinks remaining**, root preview untouched (`stopsRootPreview: false`) |

## Why the variant failed (concrete, from trace)

`seam attached: 0/10 resolved`. Every breakpoint in `seamLogpoints.mjs` is pinned by line/column to the **previous bundle** — resolved IDs read `2:7839:190104:index-C1X65dZp\.js`, but the current pinned bundle is `index-Ddqg7x9Y.js`. With zero logpoints resolved, no `begin` event fired, so the token-creation observation never occurred and my pause poll never armed: `pause: null`, `gesture: null` in `seam-events.json`.

**Consequence: no token was observed, the HUD Pause button was never clicked, and nothing about cancellation was tested.** I am not reporting any pause, cancellation, token-invalidation, or Resume result.

## Private instrumentation fixes made (authorized, private folder only)

1. Replaced the Escape-only `pause-cancel` scenario with `pause-button-cancel`: trusted `page.mouse.click` on the real HUD button (`aria-label="Pause and open star map"` ∥ `"Pause"`), fired at token age ~1.2 s (<5 s), read-only state reads only, no game setters. It explicitly sets `inconclusive` unless real paused state (`paused`/star map/Resume) is observed — button activation alone never counts as paused.
2. Repointed five stale `EXPECTED` pins (manifest, previewUrl 37395→34825, index, bundle path, bundle sha, fileCount 100→103). This was a real fault: attempt 0 aborted with `manifest hash is not the pinned one`.

Both preserved; failure capture from attempt 0 preserved.

## Explicit remaining gaps (all untested — none claimed passed)

- Actual interruption/cancellation: pause click, cancel reason, token invalidation, no reactivation after real Resume.
- Silent completed-save lifecycle: quit-to-menu → landing Continue, completed-save token absence, no completion-cue/anchor replay, no delayed unlock cue, controls/objective lifecycle.
- All variants (visibility-loss, mobile, reduced motion, low tier). No mute/context/world/actor variant was exercised.
- **Blocker for any retry:** `seamLogpoints.mjs` line/column pins must be re-derived against `index-Ddqg7x9Y.js` first; the recorder is otherwise sound.

I did not touch game source, contracts, the full suite, publishing, or producer transport/control files, and ran no static suite for the private change.

- Preserved failure (attempt 0): `…/verifier/captures/manual-credit-finale/pause-cancel-20260907T001610Z/`
